# GENERATED by cargo-arael: build glue for the `Graph` model interface. Do not edit.

#
# Consumer usage:
#   add_subdirectory(path/to/cxx)        # or FetchContent
#   target_link_libraries(app PRIVATE arael::slam_toolbox_arael)
#
# Requires a Rust toolchain (cargo builds the capi staticlib; cargo is
# its own dependency tracker, so the custom target always runs and
# no-ops when nothing changed).
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)

if(CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR STREQUAL CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR)
  project(slam_toolbox_arael_capi NONE)
endif()

set(_arael_capi_dir "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../capi")
set(_arael_cargo_target "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/cargo")
set(_arael_capi_lib "${_arael_cargo_target}/release/libslam_toolbox_arael_capi.a")

add_custom_target(slam_toolbox_arael_capi_build
  COMMAND cargo build --release
          --manifest-path "${_arael_capi_dir}/Cargo.toml"
          --target-dir "${_arael_cargo_target}"
  BYPRODUCTS "${_arael_capi_lib}"
  VERBATIM)

add_library(arael_slam_toolbox_arael STATIC IMPORTED GLOBAL)
set_target_properties(arael_slam_toolbox_arael PROPERTIES
  IMPORTED_LOCATION "${_arael_capi_lib}"
  INTERFACE_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include")
if(UNIX)
  set_property(TARGET arael_slam_toolbox_arael APPEND PROPERTY
    INTERFACE_LINK_LIBRARIES pthread dl m)
endif()
add_dependencies(arael_slam_toolbox_arael slam_toolbox_arael_capi_build)
add_library(arael::slam_toolbox_arael ALIAS arael_slam_toolbox_arael)
